title: German headline stats at phone width: the two numbers in one row sit 14 px apart
claim: In every state that shows the headline stats (6 states), at 375 px in German, in both themes, the savings and score numbers in one .hl-stats row differ in baseline by 14 px (12 of 12 such rows; 0 of 96 rows in en, sv or at 768/1280 px), because 'Voraussichtliche Einsparung' wraps to two lines and pushes its number down while 'Optimierungswert' stays on one.
mechanism: cardStyleBlock lays .hl-stat out as label (display:block) then .hl-value (display:block; margin-top:2px): each value hangs from its own label's last line, so a row whose labels wrap to different line counts has its numbers at different heights. The grid stretches the cells to one height but nothing aligns the values to a common line.

evidence.unit: count of .tiles/.hl-stats rows whose numbers differ in first-line bottom or font-size by >0.5 px (of 216 rows)
evidence.machine: box B10 (4 vCPU, Linux, Chromium 1243 via playwright 1.63.0, Node 22)
evidence.contention_note: ran beside the seat's own full-grid run; a count, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js:cardStyleBlock (.hl-stat / .hl-label / .hl-value rules), rendered by the headline of HeatpumpOptimizerCard

perturbation.change: --perturb=tile_nowrap: .tile-k and .hl-label get white-space:nowrap (one label line per cell)

metric_definition: rows of .tiles/.hl-stats cells (grouped by cell top) whose value elements' first text line bottoms or font-sizes differ by more than 0.5 px
phenomenon_property: Headline numbers that share a row share a baseline (±0.5 px) whatever the length of their labels in any shipped language, at every viewport.

null_control.note: the same rows in en and sv at 375 px and in all three languages at 768/1280 px: 0 of 96 misaligned -- the offset needs a label that wraps in one cell and not the other

reproduction_steps: Home Assistant language Deutsch, a phone (375 px wide) dashboard
Card with the savings and score sensors present; open the score or savings detail
Compare the heights of the two numbers in the stats row
proposed_fix_scope: Align the stat values to the row (e.g. a two-row subgrid for label and value, or align the value to the cell's end), not a nowrap that truncates German labels.
criteria_statement: D4-criteria P3 one look: 'headline numbers in one row share font size and baseline (±0.5 px)'
